description: Independent review of package v4.1. The reviewer is a fresh, read-only Claude Code subagent given the sources, the brief and the compiler, not the author's conclusions. The record is written by the package author from the reviewer's report; it is not an authenticated attestation (as v4 residual RV3-2).

findings.finding: The new DAG dropped the invariant-tests-first order for the save machine (T12 before T19)
findings.remediation: T19 depends on T12 again; X13 now requires every v4 transitive ordering unless an owner-decided waiver names it; the scope test asserts T12 before T19

findings.finding: Integration checkpoint 1 (T17) could run before the kernel; topology A fitted only because of it
findings.remediation: T17 depends on T13 again; A no longer fits (440) and the documents say so

findings.finding: ODR-V41-03 and the report mixed ordering and estimate effects and omitted dropped orderings
findings.remediation: schedule.json scenarios separate them; ODR-V41-03 (orderings, with the six waived orderings listed) and ODR-V41-04 (estimates) are separate requests

findings.finding: IF41-SAVE did not match SM-SAVE and SM-CONFLICT (input union, conflict states, 'inert' wording)
findings.remediation: SaveInput, ConflictView/ConflictInput, LoadState/LoadInput, ConnectionInput and NetworkInput now equal the machines' events and states; SaveMachine.Interpret produces reply events; X05 checks every machine against one interface's unions; the concurrency text follows the table

findings.finding: Contract and state-machine tests had no owner, compile entry, suite or task; producer tests owned by non-producers
findings.remediation: Every contract, state-machine and unit test is generated into an owned file (producer side by the producer, consumer side by each consumer, machine tests by the machine owner) and a suite; X04 checks producer and consumer ownership; T14 (15 min) and T19 (60 min) budget the tests
findings.status: partly fixed in round 2; completed by round-2 remediation

findings.finding: Ownership incoherent across topologies; test files assigned by first task id gave integration most PERSIST tests; AGENT-RULES disagreed
findings.remediation: ui-2 files carry ownerByTopology (ui in A and B); test files go to the first covering implementation role (domain, persistence, ui), integration only when no such task covers them; AGENT-RULES defers to the manifest; residual integration load recorded as R41-06

findings.finding: X02, X06, X07, X08, X11, X12 and X13 passed inputs they claimed to reject
findings.remediation: Each tightened (per-class bounds, status-only evidence rejected, all-pairs evidence comparison, test-requirement match, fixed integration-exclusive list, foreign properties/classes/colours rejected, structured unavailable policy, broader provenance pattern over documents too, reviewed guard partitions, precedence and estimate-floor rules); every reported bypass is a negative control in V41Tests.fs
findings.status: partly fixed in round 2; completed by round-2 remediation

findings.finding: The 163-to-9 setup saving contradicted the suites' own fixtures and justified the T31 cut
findings.remediation: Saving claim withdrawn; suites report fixture set-ups by scope; T31 back to 45; runner filters select by namespace, the same rule as membership

findings.finding: The review record was referenced but missing
findings.remediation: This record and analysis/independent-review.json

findings.finding: The manifest did not digest the documents; --check ignored stray files
findings.remediation: Documents and the decision requests are digested; --check fails on files the compiler neither generates nor reads

findings.finding: Error-matrix gaps: truncated-list budget, primary/secondary precedence, PERSIST-016 online reads, timeout not required
findings.remediation: Paging counts against the three reads; precedence rule added; NETWORK-AFTER states the online-change read and 4-in-60-s cap; X06 requires TimedOut detection

findings.finding: Weak types and a wrong versioning promise; raw credential in Msg
findings.remediation: HttpMethod, Politeness, ProviderAnswer and conflict-input unions replace strings; every union change is declared breaking; the credential is created once as the opaque Credential type
findings.status: partly fixed in round 2; completed by round-2 remediation

findings.finding: FL-06 hard-codes #E9A23B, not a Forma value
findings.remediation: The literal is cited with its UI-016 source (X07 accepts a colour only with a source); ODR-V41-05 asks the owner

findings.finding: Who performs T14 was contradictory
findings.remediation: Each producer commits its own contract block; integration only builds (AGENT-RULES duty 2)

findings.finding: Test projects declared no references; Causa.Domain.Tests empty
findings.remediation: testProjects declare references (X03 checks them, acyclic); required unit tests generate their files
findings.status: partly fixed in round 2; completed by round-2 remediation

findings.finding: The v4 manifest rewrite invalidates owner records naming its old SHA
findings.remediation: Stated in FREEZE.md

findings.finding: Pre-written contracts and the kernel waivers contradict REHEARSAL-AGENT-INTERFACE-FREEZE (author at kickoff), KICKOFF-EXECUTION-PACKET §4 and HACKATHON-BOUNDARIES (confirm organizers); the owner was not asked
findings.remediation: The owner was asked in session and stated that the organizers allow pre-kickoff scaffolding; ODR-V41-06 records it for the owner's own record and names the clauses set aside; ODR-V41-03 and the waivers cite it; the report no longer says v4.1 changes nothing but states the procedural clauses
findings.status: partly fixed in round 3; completed by round-3 remediation

findings.finding: The frozen save machine could not run multi-request save flows; MutationSent illegal everywhere
findings.remediation: The session records what it awaits (Awaiting: mutation answer, read-back, fresh head, file comparison, reconciliation head/pages/files); Interpret returns MachineEvent or NextRequest, so intermediate reads need no new state; X12 requires every unused event to be listed with a decision, and MutationSent goes to the owner (ODR-V41-08)
findings.status: partly fixed in round 3; completed by round-3 remediation

findings.finding: Interface types dropped commands, refusal reasons, per-investigation load state and load failure causes
findings.remediation: Unsaved changes and reapply carry CommandEnvelope; RefusedCommand carries the engine's reason; Model.Loads is keyed by investigation; LoadFailure distinguishes unverifiable files from provider failures

findings.finding: Test projects could not reach the stateful fake and recordings; helper order wrong; X03 ignored helpers
findings.remediation: New Causa.TestSupport project (Recordings before StatefulFake) referenced by every test project that needs it; X03 checks helper dependencies; the bootstrap builds it

findings.finding: X02, X06, X07 and X13 still passed inputs their titles reject
findings.remediation: X02 covers Directory.* build files, NuGet configuration, runsettings, tests/fixtures/ and tests/browser/support/; X06 rejects reason phrases as evidence, requires distinguishing evidence per class and bounds of the class's own kind; X07 rejects rgb/hsl colours, unhyphenated classes and foreign property families, and accepts a literal only if the cited document contains it; X13 requires waivers to name an existing decision request; each probe is a negative control

findings.finding: Contract and machine test work not budgeted; transition count wrong
findings.remediation: T14 and T16 keep v4's estimates (contract tests; SM-CONNECTION/NETWORK tests); T19 (75 transitions) and T20 (SM-LOAD) carry the machine tests; the counts are corrected
findings.status: partly fixed in round 3; completed by round-3 remediation

findings.finding: Only a lane-free critical path was reported
findings.remediation: Every topology reports its binding chain; the report distinguishes the dependency critical path (290) from topology C's makespan (320)

findings.finding: Confirmation constructible from any file in the persistence namespace
findings.remediation: Confirmation's representation is private to its module, with a byte-comparing constructor; CI compiles a forging file and requires FS1093

findings.finding: web/ funnelled to integration; R41-06 understated the integration test load
findings.remediation: web/index.html and web/causa.css are ui's (T16); R41-06 states the actual split

findings.finding: The T35 waiver reason contradicted the task
findings.remediation: T35 depends on T12 again (invariant review kept); only T13 before T35 is waived, with a corrected reason

findings.finding: Interface specs had no explicit operations, success or failure
findings.remediation: Each interface lists operations with signature, success and failure; X04 requires them, checks each name is in the contract, and rejects empty concurrency or versioning rules

findings.finding: Layout assertions tested less than the FL rules state and were not wired into the event build
findings.remediation: New assertions for each stated invariant: scroll regions accessible, line length, focus order, skip link first, dialog focus (open, trap, Escape, return), non-text contrast, forced colours, amber with a label, indicator composition, fault states what was preserved, navigation collapse; focusVisible requires a non-transparent ring of the focus-ring width that the blurred element lacks; textNotClipped detects vertical clipping and line-clamp; onlyFormaTokens reads document.styleSheets and style attributes. The reviewer's 12 defective pages are all detected except text over a gradient, which FL-06 assigns to the plan's axe run. The bootstrap writes the module to tests/browser/support/layout-assertions.mjs (integration). X15 requires every rule critical and executable, checks fixtures and composed patterns and the event-build copy, and has negative controls
findings.status: partly fixed in round 4; completed by round-4 remediation (RV41-4-1, RV41-4-2)

findings.finding: IF41-SAVE could not drive automatic reconciliation reads, load reads or conflict reads; request bookkeeping unspecified
findings.remediation: ReconcileDue sends automatic reconciliation reads on the ScheduleReconcileRead timer (TimerKey); InterpretLoad and InterpretConflict with awaited-read state (LoadAwaiting, ReadingRemote of RequestId); RequestContext carries the tab-unique NextId (the engine advances it, at most one request per operation) and MutationInFlightElsewhere for T-S04/T-S53; operations record Outstanding; producer contract tests named for each

findings.finding: No frozen type kept the repository and credential after Connect
findings.remediation: IF41-WIRE ConnectionContext (repository, branch, opaque credential) kept in Model.Context and passed in RequestContext; persistence adds the Authorization header with Credential.authorization; producer test CredentialOnlyInAuthorizationHeader

findings.finding: The §46 note asserted a dependency direction v4.1 inverts
findings.remediation: The note and project-structure.json state App -> Persistence -> Domain and mark §46's direction superseded; the R7 validator passes

findings.finding: ODR-V41-06 omitted the published organizer rules
findings.remediation: ODR-V41-06 quotes 'the repository starts empty', 'code starts at kickoff' and 'keep competition application source code out of it', and says the T10 bootstrap makes the repository non-empty before kickoff

findings.finding: Credential readable from any Causa.App file; Saved after a load needed a forged Confirmation
findings.remediation: Credential is a module type with private representation (CI negative ReadCredential.fs refused with FS1093); Saved carries SavedBasis (Confirmed of Confirmation.T, or VerifiedAt for a load or confirmed discard, subject to ODR-V4-08)

findings.finding: X02 accepted contributors on integration files and a dropped boundary script; X04 trivial outcomes; X15 without controls; CI step name
findings.remediation: X02 rejects contributors on integration-exclusive files and requires the essential shared files in the manifest; X04 requires stated outcomes; X15 controls added; the step names X01-X15

findings.finding: The bootstrap's scope was described more broadly than it is
findings.remediation: README, the report and AGENT-RULES state it is the .NET skeleton (plus the layout module); package references, integration's other shared files and test-framework wiring come at T10 (ODR-V41-07)

findings.finding: T19 and T22 estimate basis
findings.remediation: T22 restored to 70 (dependency critical path now 300; the experimental target is reported as not met); T19's rationale states why 60 minutes holds and that it is off the critical path

ownerAdjustments.bootstrap: achieved for an empty directory; git-initialised directory refused (RV41-4-4)

findings.finding: The layout assertions missed common violations of their invariants
findings.remediation: Overflow checks include html and body and any content past the viewport; clipping compares each text range with its clipping ancestors; line length measures running text anywhere; dialogFocus fails when the invoker does not open the dialog (only a declared show-modal command is carried out in a browser without invoker commands); indicatorComposed is scoped to the header carrying the lozenge and checks order; faultStatesPreserved rejects statements that work was lost; contrast accounts for ancestor opacity and waits for entry animations; also skip link visible on focus, ring contrast, hidden scroll bars, late animations, empty navs, clickable non-controls, colour-only lozenges, unreadable linked stylesheets. 46 broken pages; the reviewer's 18 defect pages are all caught except two that do not violate the rule at that viewport or with Forma's ring
findings.status: not fixed in round 5; completed by round-5 remediation (RV41-5-1)

findings.finding: X15 did not enforce per-invariant coverage
findings.remediation: Each rule lists its invariants and the assertions that test each; X15 fails if an invariant's assertion is not run or a run assertion tests no invariant; negative controls added

findings.finding: No frozen contract drove SM-CONNECTION
findings.remediation: IF41-ERRORS Connector (ConnectRequest, InterpretConnect -> ConnectResult; write access only from stated permissions, EXT-DATA-005); ConnectionState Connecting of RequestId; producer test WriteAccessOnlyFromPermissions

findings.finding: --bootstrap refused a git-initialised repository
findings.remediation: A .git directory is allowed; CI now runs git init before the bootstrap

findings.finding: The report summarised ODR-V41-06 as two clauses
findings.remediation: The report names all three groups, including the published event rules

findings.finding: Duplicate union-case names caused type errors
findings.remediation: The machines' input unions and NetworkState require qualified access; contracts/99-Usage.fs is a positive control CI compiles
findings.status: partly fixed in round 5; completed by round-5 remediation (RV41-5-2)

findings.finding: .gitignore unowned and not bootstrapped; onlyFormaTokens exempted any forma*.css
findings.remediation: `.gitignore` is integration's (X02) and written by the bootstrap; only Forma's own stylesheet (default /dist/all.css, configurable) is exempt

ownerAdjustments.executableLayoutTests: partly: about half of common real defects missed (RV41-5-1)

findings.finding: The layout assertions still missed about half of a wider set of real defects (50 of 95), and the round-4 record overstated coverage ('measures running text anywhere' was then false)
findings.remediation:
Shared in-page helpers judge what is actually painted (the background beneath an element on screen, real visibility, visible text, clipping ancestors). The assertions now cover:
• line length for any element with 80+ characters of its own text;
• focus rings clipped by a container and rings without contrast;
• all border sides, switch tracks and SVG icons for non-text contrast;
• loaders announced by their own name or a live region;
• visible, uncovered lozenge text;
• amber in SVG fill, shadows and gradients;
• `::-webkit-scrollbar` hiding, skip links hidden by clip-path or transparent text, and controls skipped by script;
• script-driven motion, sampled over time;
• async focus moves after a dialog closes;
• disabled or hidden fault actions;
• text over sibling backgrounds, input values and placeholders;
• contain: paint and clip-path clipping;
• colour-only markers, covered indicators, and off-screen, aria-hidden or unlabelled navs;
• custom menus beside the Forma shell;
• adopted stylesheets and @property.
On the reviewer's 110 runs, 96 are caught; the 14 others are 13 non-violations and the disclosed gradient case. 69 broken pages. R41-11 lists the remaining limits

findings.finding: Conflict was still an ambiguous union case (Decision and SaveState)
findings.remediation: SaveState requires qualified access; 99-Usage.fs matches Decision.Conflict and builds SaveState.Conflict; X04 rejects any case name shared by two unqualified unions across the contracts, with a negative control
